name: Kakaku.com, Inc.
summary: Kakaku.com, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides purchase support, restaurant review, and other services in Japan. It operates through four segments: Kakaku.com Business, Tabelog Business, Job Box Business, and Incubation Business. It operates Kakaku.com that provides prices, specifications, and user reviews on various products and services, such as computers, home appliances and smartphones, furniture, fashion, internet providers, and insurance and loans to help users make informed decisions; Job Box, is an earn commission from job posting businesses and hiring companies; and Tabelog.com, a restaurant discovery and reservation service site.
